desc:
🎂 Live a whole life, one year at a time! Be born somewhere in the world, grow up, go to school and choose your path.

💼 Build a career: athlete, lawyer, soldier, doctor, entrepreneur and many more, with minigames for your job
🎓 Go to school and college, sit exams and make friends
❤️ Fall in love, start a family and raise your kids
🏡 Buy homes, flip properties and become a landlord
📈 Start businesses, trade stocks and grow your net worth
⭐ Become famous, or run a heist crew (no weapons, just brains)
🌳 When your life ends, keep playing as your child and grow your family tree
🏆 Climb the live server leaderboards

Every choice changes your story. What kind of life will you live? 👑

👍 Like and ⭐ Favourite to support the game!
